notes.title: STYLY 2.0 Official Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30768274/64fc2ed5919e7a72fb7c16865f352cdd1ed316ba.jpg[/img]
With this update, STYLY will be upgraded to the latest version of 2.0.
We recommend choosing the Unity2019.3.6f1 for your upgrade to Unity2019.
(Hereinafter, we will refer to the new STYLY System as STYLY 2.0, and the upgraded STYLY Studio as STYLY Studio 2.0.)
[url=https://styly.cc/feature/upgrade-to-unity2019/] Scheduled Update on April 13, 2020: “STYLY 2.0 Official Release: Upgrading Your Unity to Unity2019”[/url]

As for the existing STYLY scenes, it is possible that the look and behavior of the STYLY scenes will be different after this update.
The main issues that may arise are described in the article above.

If you've tested it on STYLY 2.0 and have any problems with the look or behavior, you'll need to migrate it to Unity2019.
Please refer to the link below for details of the migration process.
[url=https://styly.cc/manual/reupload-from-unity2019/]【Unity2019】Methods for Resolving Issues that Occur in Developed Scenes Converted from STYLY to STYLY 2.0[/url]
